validity_note: Laliberte (2009) aqueous-electrolyte correlation for MnSO4-water, density and viscosity. Tabulated for 2-30 wt% over 20-25 degC. The narrow 20-25 degC temperature span is the full window of the correlation's MnSO4 density data; the table is held to it rather than extrapolated. Heat capacity is not tabulated (the correlation's MnSO4 heat-capacity data is a single 35 degC point). Manganese(II) sulfate is very soluble (above 35 wt% at 20 degC), so the 30 wt% ceiling stays below saturation. Concentrations are anhydrous MnSO4 by mass; the common monohydrate is about 89% MnSO4 by mass. Values are for preliminary design; verify against vendor data for critical service.
